quirks: NOT TESTED — nothing was paid. qa-pay/Sponge facilitator returned 'No compatible payment options found' on 2 attempts despite the wallet holding $26.61 USDC on Base.

ROOT CAUSE: the endpoint's v2 402 accepts entries omit an explicit 'asset' (token contract) field on the Base options, so the Sponge payment matcher cannot resolve a compatible payment option. Needs a payer that defaults the asset to USDC for asset-less eip155 accepts (or use the permit2 variant explicitly).

PRICE MISMATCH: actual 402 quote is $1.75, not the $0.500 registry surface. accepts offer eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:137 (Polygon), and Solana, all at $1.75, payTo 0x0E84dDEdAaE6A779c462C22a59F301EC31B6b808 (EVM).
Body field is 'prompt' (text-to-video); model param value is 'sora-2' per registry modelParam.

existingUsage in the registry points at a DIFFERENT backend URL (https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with model 'azure/sora-2') that was previously verified — that is NOT this x402.ottoai.services/video-gen endpoint.
Likely async: budget for a paid POST plus paid polls once a compatible payer can complete the POST.
usage.guide: POST https://x402.ottoai.services/video-gen with JSON {"prompt":"<your prompt>","model":"sora-2"} and an x402 payment. The live 402 quote is $1.75 USDC (Base, Polygon, or Solana) — not the $0.500 listed. COULD NOT BE TESTED in this run: the Sponge payer rejected all payment options as incompatible because the endpoint's Base accepts omit an explicit asset (token) field, even though the wallet held $26.61 USDC on Base. To test, use a payer that defaults asset-less eip155 accepts to USDC or explicitly selects the permit2 Base accepts variant. Once payment goes through, expect an async video-generation job that must be polled for the finished video URL.
